passages.text: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is King.
The LORD wears majesty like a robe.
The LORD puts on strength as His clothing.
The LORD arms Himself with power.
The world stands firm.
Nothing can move the world.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֪וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף־ תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל־ תִּמּֽוֹט׃

passages.text: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God’s throne stands firm.
God established His throne long ago.
God exists from all eternity.

passages.text: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
passages.sermon: The rivers rise, O LORD.\r\nThe rivers lift up their voices.\r\nThe rivers lift up their roaring waves.
passages.original: נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דָּכְיָֽם׃

passages.text: Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is on high.
The LORD is majestic.
Many waters roar.
The sea has mighty breakers.
The LORD is more majestic than the mighty waves.
passages.original: מִקֹּל֨וֹת׀ מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־ יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּמָּר֣וֹם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
The LORD’s house is holy.
The LORD’s testimonies are true.
The LORD’s testimonies are completely reliable.
Holiness belongs in the LORD’s house.
Holiness will remain in the LORD’s house forever.
passages.original: עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ׀ נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְבֵיתְךָ֥ נַאֲוָה־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
